title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实
missingSignals: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA.
